question: Does locked FUSED3 preserve refined OI's nonlinear backbone-ranking utility and linear-probe competitiveness across all frozen Food-101 budgets and replicates while remaining faster than both comparators?

methods.FUSED3: locked deterministic three-step fused class-owned prototype relevance selector
methods.REFINED-OI: fresh direct balanced-median refined OverlapIndex comparator using the archived MiniBatchKMeans recipe
methods.LP-FULL: fresh five-fold Normalizer plus LogisticRegression comparator
methods.REFINED-OI-ARCHIVED: hash-frozen prior refined-OI score rows, analysis-only historical comparator

environment.reason: exactly preserve the valid locked FUSED3 screen environment

execution.fold_seed: panel_seed + fold for FUSED3 and REFINED-OI; panel_seed for LP-FULL
execution.order: three-method cyclic exact counterbalance; every method occupies every position 200 times
execution.warmup: one excluded clock-free exact repeat per method on its first frozen panel
execution.checkpoint: one complete paired three-method panel written atomically
execution.resume: fail closed on protocol, source, environment, cache, screen lock, panel, subset, method, checkpoint, or determinism mismatch
execution.runtime: outer wall and CPU clocks include method-required preprocessing, all five folds, fitting, and scoring; cache loading and common panel construction excluded

statistics.selection_ties: average downstream outcome across selector scores equal within atol=1e-12
statistics.rank_auc: within each complete replicate-method-arm-head curve, integrate Spearman over the four frozen budgets with a trapezoid normalized in log2 budget space; any undefined budget makes the curve undefined and the required rank-retention gate fail closed
statistics.ranking_block: within each replicate average the four frozen budget deltas equally, then paired percentile bootstrap five replicate blocks
statistics.runtime_block: within each replicate take the median across ten backbones and four budgets, then paired percentile bootstrap five replicate blocks
statistics.full_panel_runtime_block: within replicate and budget sum all ten backbone wall times before taking the candidate/comparator ratio; average budgets equally within replicate; bootstrap five replicate blocks

required_gates.clean_linear_vs_probe: FUSED3 minus LP-FULL regret upper95 <= 1.0 accuracy point
required_gates.nuisance_linear_vs_probe: FUSED3 minus LP-FULL regret upper95 <= 1.0 accuracy point
required_gates.nonlinear_vs_probe: for quadratic, knn, and rbf, FUSED3 minus LP-FULL regret upper95 <= 1.0 point each
required_gates.nonlinear_retention_fresh_refined: for quadratic, knn, and rbf, FUSED3 minus fresh REFINED-OI regret upper95 <= 1.0 point each
required_gates.nonlinear_retention_archived_refined: for quadratic, knn, and rbf, FUSED3 minus REFINED-OI-ARCHIVED regret upper95 <= 1.0 point each
required_gates.nonlinear_rank_retention: for quadratic, knn, and rbf, lower95 of paired replicate-level FUSED3 minus fresh REFINED-OI normalized log2-budget rank AUC >= -0.10 each
required_gates.fresh_refined_historical_stability: for quadratic, knn, and rbf, fresh REFINED-OI minus archived refined regret upper95 <= 1.0 point each
required_gates.runtime_per_call: within every arm, median FUSED3/comparator <= 1.0 and upper95 <= 1.10 for LP-FULL and REFINED-OI
required_gates.runtime_full_panel: within every arm, median summed-panel FUSED3/comparator <= 1.0 and upper95 <= 1.10 for LP-FULL and REFINED-OI
required_gates.screen_overlap_parity: all 30 overlapping FUSED3 panel scores exactly match the locked screen
required_gates.linear_probe_archived_parity: all 600 fresh LP-FULL scores exactly match the hash-frozen replay
required_gates.loop_fused_design_parity: inherited from the hash-bound locked screen
required_gates.determinism: all three executed methods have exact clock-free warmup/repeat signatures

descriptive_claims.nonlinear_superiority: established per head only when FUSED3 minus LP-FULL regret upper95 < 0
descriptive_claims.faster_than_comparator: established per arm/comparator only when both per-call and full-panel upper95 < 1.0
descriptive_claims.refined_score_exact_match_rate: report fresh versus archived refined score equality and maximum absolute delta without using it as a promotion veto

decision.pass: pass_full_retrospective when every required gate passes
decision.fail: fail_locked_candidate when any required gate fails

claim_scope: Retrospective Food-101 evidence under the archived class-balanced sampling protocol. No untouched confirmation, public API change, or Vertebrae modification.
